title: Treatment
description: A disposal or recovery operation applied to the waste, and the weight of waste it applies to. Both are required. disposalOrRecoveryCode mirrors DISPOSAL_OR_RECOVERY_CODES from @defra/waste-movement-utils.

disposalOrRecoveryCode.description: The recovery (R1–R13) or disposal (D1–D15) operation code. Case-sensitive.

weight.description: The weight of waste this treatment applies to.
